questions.name: Total cash pool · selected date
questions.description: Loan Reports · proposed (cash.pool-selected). Native, same routing as question 207: today reads model 73 Total Cash Pool, a past date reads model 205 Total Cash Pool for that date; blank when no snapshot exists. Basis: snippet 4 Cash position source routing (models 205, 73).

stages.native:
WITH clock AS (SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date AS today),
 dates AS (SELECT generate_series(coalesce((SELECT min("Date") FROM {{#205}}),c.today),c.today,interval '1 day')::date AS "Date" FROM clock c),
 selected AS (SELECT max(d."Date") AS position_date FROM dates d WHERE true [[AND {{position_date}}]])
SELECT CASE WHEN s.position_date=c.today THEN (SELECT p."Total Cash Pool" FROM {{#73}} p LIMIT 1)
 WHEN s.position_date<c.today THEN (SELECT p."Total Cash Pool" FROM {{#205}} p WHERE p."Date"=s.position_date ORDER BY p."Generated At" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) END AS "Total Cash Pool"
FROM selected s CROSS JOIN clock c

questions.name: Principal outstanding · selected date
questions.description: Loan Reports · proposed (cash.principal-selected). Native, same routing as question 207, selecting Outstanding Principal. Basis: snippet 4 Cash position source routing (models 205, 73).

stages.native:
WITH clock AS (SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date AS today),
 dates AS (SELECT generate_series(coalesce((SELECT min("Date") FROM {{#205}}),c.today),c.today,interval '1 day')::date AS "Date" FROM clock c),
 selected AS (SELECT max(d."Date") AS position_date FROM dates d WHERE true [[AND {{position_date}}]])
SELECT CASE WHEN s.position_date=c.today THEN (SELECT p."Outstanding Principal" FROM {{#73}} p LIMIT 1)
 WHEN s.position_date<c.today THEN (SELECT p."Outstanding Principal" FROM {{#205}} p WHERE p."Date"=s.position_date ORDER BY p."Generated At" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) END AS "Outstanding Principal"
FROM selected s CROSS JOIN clock c

questions.name: This period and the previous period
questions.description: Loan Reports · proposed (income.vs-previous). Native: for the selected statement period and the immediately preceding period of equal length, one row per measure (Income, Expenses, Net profit, Net profit per day) with This period, Previous period, Change and Change %. Previous period blank before the reporting calendar. Whole baht, one-decimal percent. Basis: snippet 2 Income statement period (model 186 Income Events).

stages.native:
WITH selected AS (SELECT d."Date" FROM public.reporting_statement_calendar d WHERE true [[AND {{statement_period}}]]),
 available AS (SELECT min("Date") starts FROM public.reporting_statement_calendar),
 bounds AS (SELECT min("Date") starts,max("Date") ends,count(*)::int days FROM selected),
 periods AS (
 SELECT 'this' p,b.starts,b.ends,b.days,true ok FROM bounds b WHERE b.days>0 AND b.days=b.ends-b.starts+1
 UNION ALL SELECT 'previous',b.starts-b.days,b.starts-1,b.days,b.starts-b.days>=a.starts FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN available a WHERE b.days>0 AND b.days=b.ends-b.starts+1
 ), totals AS (
 SELECT p.p,p.ok,p.days,coalesce((SELECT sum(e."Income") FROM {{#186}} e WHERE e."Date" BETWEEN p.starts AND p.ends),0) income,
 coalesce((SELECT sum(e."Expenses") FROM {{#186}} e WHERE e."Date" BETWEEN p.starts AND p.ends),0) expenses FROM periods p
 ), m AS (
 SELECT v.ord,v.metric,max(v.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.p='this') cur,max(v.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.p='previous' AND t.ok) prev
 FROM totals t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1,'Income',t.income),(2,'Expenses',t.expenses),(3,'Net profit',t.income-t.expenses),(4,'Net profit per day',(t.income-t.expenses)/nullif(t.days,0))) v(ord,metric,amount)
 GROUP BY v.ord,v.metric
 )
SELECT metric AS "Measure",cur AS "This period",prev AS "Previous period",cur-prev AS "Change",(cur-prev)/nullif(abs(prev),0) AS "Change %" FROM m ORDER BY ord

questions.name: Monthly income, expenses and net profit
questions.description: Loan Reports · proposed (income.monthly). One shared y-axis so expenses read at true scale. Basis: model 186 Income Events.

questions.name: Cash movement by transaction type · chart
questions.description: Loan Reports · proposed (cashflow.by-type-row). Question 203's query wrapped: TOTAL row and rows with no movement removed, ordered by Money In + Money Out descending. Horizontal bars of Money In (green) and Money Out (red), stacked (stackable.stack_type = stacked): on this version Metabase folds unstacked row-chart categories into "Other (n)" regardless of graph.max_categories_enabled; each type moves money one way, so stacking changes nothing visually. Basis: snippet 3 Cashflow statement period (same query as question 203).

stages.native: SELECT * FROM (WITH statement AS ({{snippet: Cashflow statement period}}) SELECT CASE WHEN grouping(t."Transaction Type")=1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE t."Transaction Type" END AS "Transaction Type",coalesce(sum(t."Money In"),0) AS "Money In",coalesce(sum(t."Money Out"),0) AS "Money Out",coalesce(sum(t."Net Movement"),0) AS "Net Movement" FROM statement s LEFT JOIN LATERAL public.reporting_cash_period_entries(s."Period Start",s."Period End",{{cash_account}}) t ON true WHERE s."Continuous Period" GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t."Transaction Type"),()) HAVING bool_or(s."Continuous Period") AND (grouping(t."Transaction Type")=1 OR count(t."Entry ID")>0) ORDER BY grouping(t."Transaction Type"),1) t WHERE t."Transaction Type"<>'TOTAL' AND (coalesce(t."Money In",0)<>0 OR coalesce(t."Money Out",0)<>0) ORDER BY coalesce(t."Money In",0)+coalesce(t."Money Out",0) DESC,t."Transaction Type"

questions.name: This period and the previous period
questions.description: Loan Reports · proposed (perf.vs-previous). Native: for the selected Period and the preceding period of equal length, one row per measure: Gross interest, Principal issued, Loans issued, Principal returned and Net principal deployed (issued − returned), with This period, Previous period, Change and Change %. Same date rules as questions 217–219. Basis: models 71 Repayment Ledger and 70 Loan Book (pattern of questions 217–219).

stages.native:
WITH clock AS (SELECT public.olap_reporting_date() today),
 available AS (SELECT min("Date") starts FROM public.reporting_statement_calendar),
 selected AS (
 SELECT d."Date" FROM (SELECT generate_series(DATE '1900-01-01',DATE '2199-12-31',INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS "Date") d
 WHERE [[{{performance_period}} --]] d."Date" BETWEEN (SELECT starts FROM available) AND (SELECT today FROM clock)
 ), bounds AS (SELECT min("Date") starts,max("Date") ends,count(*)::int days,
 count(*)>0 AND count(*)=max("Date")-min("Date")+1 continuous FROM selected),
 periods AS (
 SELECT 'this' p,b.starts,least(b.ends,c.today) ends,b.starts>=a.starts ok FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN clock c CROSS JOIN available a WHERE b.continuous
 UNION ALL SELECT 'previous',b.starts-b.days,b.starts-1,b.starts-b.days>=a.starts FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN available a WHERE b.continuous
 ), totals AS (
 SELECT p.p,p.ok,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(s."Interest Paid"),0) FROM {{#71}} s WHERE s."Payment Date" BETWEEN p.starts AND p.ends) interest,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(s."Principal Amount"),0) FROM {{#70}} s WHERE s."Loan Date" BETWEEN p.starts AND p.ends) issued,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM {{#70}} s WHERE s."Loan Date" BETWEEN p.starts AND p.ends) loans,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(s."Principal Paid"),0) FROM {{#71}} s WHERE s."Payment Date" BETWEEN p.starts AND p.ends) returned
 FROM periods p
 ), m AS (
 SELECT v.ord,v.metric,max(v.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.p='this') cur,max(v.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.p='previous' AND t.ok) prev
 FROM totals t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1,'Gross interest',t.interest),(2,'Principal issued',t.issued),(3,'Loans issued',t.loans::numeric),(4,'Principal returned',t.returned),(5,'Net principal deployed',t.issued-t.returned)) v(ord,metric,amount)
 GROUP BY v.ord,v.metric
 )
SELECT metric AS "Measure",cur AS "This period",prev AS "Previous period",cur-prev AS "Change",(cur-prev)/nullif(abs(prev),0) AS "Change %" FROM m ORDER BY ord

questions.name: Capital share · full pool
questions.description: Loan Reports · proposed (partners.capital-share-row). Question 331's query with Capital share % (each row's share of the rows) as the plotted value. Basis: model 318 Partners · position source (same query as question 331).

stages.native:
SELECT "Partner","Net capital ฿"/nullif(sum("Net capital ฿") OVER (),0) AS "Capital share %","Net capital ฿" FROM (WITH pool AS (
 SELECT d.partner_id,d.partner_name,d.partner_role,d.net_capital,d.capital_share
 FROM {{#318}} d
), chosen AS (
 SELECT d.* FROM pool d WHERE true [[AND {{partner}}]]
), slices AS (
 SELECT partner_name AS label,net_capital AS amount,1 AS sort_order FROM chosen
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Other partners',sum(p.net_capital),2
 FROM pool p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chosen c WHERE c.partner_id=p.partner_id)
 HAVING count(*)>0 AND sum(p.net_capital)>0
)
SELECT label AS "Partner",amount AS "Net capital ฿"
FROM slices
WHERE amount>0 AND (SELECT bool_and(net_capital>=0 AND capital_share IS NOT NULL) AND sum(net_capital)>0 FROM pool)
ORDER BY sort_order,label) t

SELECT v."Item",v."People",v."Amount ฿",v."Opens",v."Tab",v."Tint" FROM (VALUES

 (2,'🔴 Not paid today',coalesce((SELECT people FROM s WHERE status='Not Paid'),0)::bigint,(SELECT remaining FROM s WHERE status='Not Paid')::numeric,'Collection','383','not_paid'),
